notes: Annotation is the primary output; forecasting and imputation are downstream evaluations using an inherited Time-MMD framework, not new forecasting/imputation modules. Temporal-validity evidence is limited to an OLMo training-data contamination ablation, with no stated chronological split or availability-time guard. Human preferences assess informativeness, not downstream decision utility. The numerical toolbox is a contributed integration of standard transforms. Source decontextualization, textual feature extraction and offline scoring are grouped as a common-knowledge preparation procedure; domain-term extraction, rewriting and review form one coupled refinement loop.
